verdict.rationale: Cross-merchant network signals are a fair axis for a fraud-scoring product, but nothing in the pack says Radar's scoring draws on data from other businesses. The closest item, the 'network of related payments' in risk insights, explicitly covers only other payments made to your own business using the same customer ID, IP, or card. The other items describe rules, lists, review queues, and general out-of-the-box protection, with no reference to signals pooled across merchants.
